note: Closed output contracts for the governed bridge op POST /v1/llm_step (AGENTS.md §23.23 LLM steps). A schema here must be closed: every property declared, no extra keys accepted, and every field named in decision_fields a string with a non-empty enum. n8n branches on decision fields only; every other field is display. A caller may narrow a decision field's enum per call (allowed_values), never widen it. process_ids binds a schema to the registered processes that may use it. Read by scripts/lib/bridge_llm_step.py; validation is the structural check in scripts/lib/n8n_model_job.py.

lane_failure_decision/v1.description: Closed decision form of lane_failure_diagnosis/v1 for n8n: action_id is enumerated (the remediation catalogue's rules.action_ids plus suggest_only, pinned by test against config/n8n_remediation_catalogue.json). The host re-checks the chosen action against the lane's catalogue entry before anything runs (scripts/lib/n8n_failure_diagnosis.py check_verdict / decide).
